notes.note: Speaker labels in this slice run one row late. Speakers re-derived from event scripts 0706-0710 (script index n = table row 0.n, as confirmed by content): 0706 #0.51/0.54/0.57 Ankh; #0.53/0.55/0.56/0.58 Seravee's Voice. 0707 #0.1/0.17/0.19 Ankh, #0.18 Seravee's Voice. 0708 #0.2/0.20/0.41 Ankh, #0.1/0.3/0.47/0.48 God Gundam, #0.25 Gundam Head.

Leader-variant block #0.2-0.16 follows the Pt_Chara_Check order: God Gundam, Nu Gundam, Wing Zero, Zeta Gundam, 00, Taro, Ultraman, Mebius, Seven, Zero, Den-O Sword Form, Rider 1, W, Black RX, OOO. The same order covers 0708 #0.5-0.19 (#0.5 empty), #0.26-0.40 cries and #0.52-0.66 (#0.52 empty). Identical Japanese gets identical English.
Tentacles rendered plural (the area is full of them; next event mentions tangled tentacles blocking the passage).
Source ends with a stray closing corner bracket (typo); dropped.
The 'guy' Ankh refers to is the Devil Gundam; rendered 'that thing' (glossary g=n).
Seravee's reply (script +20) is an empty table entry; the answer comes in event 0709.
Rows #0.1-0.3 and #0.47-0.48 only play when God Gundam is the leader (script branch); otherwise the leader variants and Ankh's #0.20 play.
Gundam Head roar, first appearance; new roar 'Gyurururururururu!!!' (add to roars list).
Not referenced by the 0708 script; read as the Gundam Head's roar (likely its defeat cry) and rendered 'Gwoooooooooh...!!'. Speaker uncertain.
Ankh to the leader after the leader is hit; yaru zo rendered 'Let's take it down!!'.
Seravee's Voice (Veda locating the Memory and sending it to the map); script runs Seravee then Ankh here, but the line is clearly Seravee's.
System OK-window text before the Gundam Head battle prompt; written impersonally.

report: Speaker labels were shifted by one row; all speakers re-derived from scripts 0706-0710 (see notes). #0.43 of 0708 is unreferenced by the script (read as a Gundam Head roar). New roar for Gundam Head. 'Memory Memory' kept as in story_146. No new names.
